therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Dual PD-L1/TGF-β inhibition combined with IL-12 immunocytokine activation and stereotactic radiation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced anti-tumor immune response through checkpoint inhibition, TGF-β blockade, IL-12-mediated immune activation, and radiation-induced immunogenic cell death
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Adults with advanced pancreatic cancer (unresectable, borderline resectable, or metastatic)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Recommended Phase 2 Dose determination, safety assessment, and best overall response by RECIST

results.dose_information: M7824 IV on Days 1 and 15 of every cycle, M9241 subcutaneous on Day 1 of every cycle, SBRT starting Day 17 of Cycle 1 for 5 consecutive days
